standard_prerequisites.name: Fibre products in the big pro-etale sites agree with those of schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that the big pro-etale sites have fibre products agreeing with fibre products in the category of schemes

core_obligations: Apply the criterion twice (proof lines 6614-6620): the inclusion of the smaller big pro-etale site into the larger one, and the inclusion of the corresponding relative sites over a fixed object S, are checked against the criterion for a bigger site.

Verify the conditions (proof lines 6620-6628): conditions (b), (c) and (e) of the criterion are immediate for both inclusions, condition (a) holds by the refinement lemma for pro-etale coverings, and condition (d) holds because fibre products exist in both and are compatible with fibre products of schemes, hence preserved by the inclusion.

Conclude (proof lines 6628-6630): consequently there are morphisms of topoi g and f between the categories of sheaves of the two sites with f composed with g isomorphic to the identity, and the same for the relative sites over any object S of the smaller site.
proof_roadmap: Apply the bigger-site criterion to the absolute and to the relative pro-etale sites.
Check the five conditions, using the refinement lemma for coverings and the compatibility of fibre products.
Read off the morphisms of topoi with the stated composite property.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for two big pro-etale sites with one contained in the other, the inclusion functors on both the absolute and the relative sites satisfy the criterion for a bigger site, so that there are morphisms of topoi g and f with f composed with g isomorphic to the identity (statement lines 6591-6621). The proof (proof lines 6623-6633) verifies the five conditions of the criterion, using the refinement of pro-etale coverings for condition (a) and the compatibility of fibre products for condition (d). H2: a criterion check with three inputs, written out in full.
